in_sanskrit.name: Sahbaj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Brave, Fearless, Lion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sahbaj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sahbaj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sah-bhaaj', which means 'lion's share'. It is a name that conveys strength, courage, and wisdom. Sahbaj is a name for a child who is destined to be a fearless leader, one who takes on challenges with bravery and determination.
